Class StructureLevel

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Nested
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

The structure one optional or repeated schema node adds to a column: validity for an optional node, offsets for a repeated one. Create it with ForOptional(SchemaNode, bool[]) or ForRepeated(SchemaNode, int[]).

Offsets

For a repeated node, one entry more than the items of the enclosing level: the elements of item i are the elements Offsets[i] up to (not including) Offsets[i + 1]. The first offset is 0.
